caption: The video captures a person in a gray puffer jacket on a grassy slope beneath a misty mountain, holding two long reddish poles whose joined strings form a giant bubble wand. A white bucket rests nearby. An iridescent soap film is already extending from the wand into a large sheet, glowing with rainbow patches. As the person keeps both arms raised, the sheet draws outward into a long irregular shape bulging into rounded lobes. The rainbow reflections broaden while the structure drifts steadily rightward, away from the wand. The loop is left with a thin trailing film. The bubble mass keeps growing and undulating without visibly popping, and the figure shifts a little leftward within the frame.
